title: Generate Parentheses
description:
Given n pairs of parentheses, print every well-formed (balanced) combination.

Input format
Line 1: n.

Output format
All balanced strings of length 2n, one per line, in lexicographic (dictionary) order where "(" comes before ")".
hints: A string is balanced if no prefix has more ")" than "(" and the totals are equal. Build the string one character at a time.
Use recursion with two counters: how many "(" and ")" have been used. You may add "(" while open < n, and ")" while close < open.
To get lexicographic order without sorting, always try "(" before ")" at each step.

examples.explanation: Five balanced strings exist for n = 3, listed in dictionary order.
